######ANALYSIS OF STROMAL SUBCLUSTERS:PERCENTAGE OF DONORS, AVERAGE EXPRESSION AND CORRELATION#########


#THE PATH
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(rprojroot)

# Trouve automatiquement le dossier racine du projet (là où est ton fichier .Rproj)
project_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("LAB_DOCS.Rproj"))

# Définit ce dossier comme racine pour tout le document
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

# (optionnel) Vérifie le chemin
cat("Root directory for knitting:", knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "\n")
set.seed(123)
```



```{r}
##packages
library(pacman)
p_load(Seurat,SeuratData,Matrix,dplyr,DropletUtils,presto,gprofiler2,ggplot2,patchwork,gplots,cowplot,gprofiler2,openxlsx, plyr,scDblFinder,BiocParallel)
```



#1-LOAD THE DATA

```{r}
##load the data: from the initial code harmony2.rmd

stromal_obj = readRDS("data/process/temp/stromal_subset.rds")
table(stromal_obj$celltype)

```


#2NORM, FVF, SCALE AND RUNPCA
```{r}
##the same process
#normalize,scale, run_pca, findvarfeature
stromal_obj = NormalizeData(stromal_obj)
stromal_obj = FindVariableFeatures(stromal_obj)
stromal_obj = ScaleData(stromal_obj,vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
stromal_obj = RunPCA(stromal_obj)
```



#3PERFORM INTEGRATION
```{r}

##perform integration: no need to join layers###
library(harmony)
stromal_obj =RunHarmony(
  stromal_obj, 
  group.by.vars = "orig.ident",
  orig.reduction = "pca", 
  dims.use = 1:30
)
Reductions(stromal_obj) # to check harmony: run succesfully

#visualization
stromal_obj = RunUMAP(stromal_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
p1=DimPlot(
  stromal_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = c("sample"),
 label.size = 2, shuffle = T
)
p1 
```



#4-CHECK THE TRESHOLD FOR THE PCA AND THE RESOLUTION BEFORE FINDING THE CLUSTERS AFTER INTEGRATION.BASED ON DATA SIZE , WE CAN CHOSE A RANGE OF RESOLUTION

```{r}
#use ans ELBOWPLOT:shows the variance explained by each principal component (PC).You use it to decide how many PCs to keep
ElbowPlot(stromal_obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca") +
  ggtitle("Elbow plot - Stromal sample")
```


#4-1 PERFORM DIFFERENT RESOLUTION
```{r}
#1 Build the nearest-neighbor graph (required before clustering)
stromal_obj <- FindNeighbors(stromal_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")

#2 Create clusters at resolutions from 0.3 to 1.0
for (res in seq(0.1,1, by = 0.1)) {
  stromal_obj <- FindClusters(stromal_obj, resolution = res)
}

#3 Get all clustering resolution columns from metadata
res_cols <- grep("RNA_snn_res", colnames(stromal_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)


#4 Plot each resolution separately
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(stromal_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction =  "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
}

#5 (Optional) Combine all plots into one grid for comparison
library(patchwork)

plots <- lapply(res_cols, function(res) {
  DimPlot(stromal_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
    ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
})

wrap_plots(plots)

```

#4-2CLUSTERS NOW

```{r}
### clusters after integration
stromal_obj = FindNeighbors(stromal_obj, reduction="harmony", dims = 1:30)
stromal_obj = FindClusters(stromal_obj, resolution =0.6, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters") 
```


#5-PLOT FOR CLUSTERS
```{r}
##plots with the clusters

library(RColorBrewer)

# Number of clusters
n_clusters <- length(levels(Idents(stromal_obj)))

# Create enough distinct colors
if(n_clusters <= 12){
  my_colors <- brewer.pal(n_clusters, "Paired")
} else {
  # For more than 12 clusters, interpolate a larger palette
  my_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n_clusters)
}

# Set identities if not already
Idents(stromal_obj) <- "seurat_clusters"  # replace with your cluster column

# Plot
p = DimPlot(
  stromal_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  label = TRUE,
  label.size = 5,
  repel = TRUE,
  cols = my_colors
)
p
```


#6-FIND ALL MARKERS IN ALL CLUSTERS
```{r}
##find all markers###########################
#first
all_markers_stromal <- FindAllMarkers(
  stromal_obj,
  only.pos = TRUE,     # only genes upregulated in each cluster
  min.pct = 0.25,      # minimum % of cells expressing the gene
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
# 2️⃣ Keep only significant markers
all_markers_stromal <- all_markers_stromal %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)

library(openxlsx)
# save (important)
write.xlsx(
  all_markers_stromal,
  file = "output/temp/all_markers_stromal.xlsx"
)


#######this is to extract the top 30 markers ########

#1️⃣ Add gene and cluster info
all_markers_stromal$feature <- all_markers_stromal$gene
all_markers_stromal$group <- all_markers_stromal$cluster



# 3️⃣ Get cluster IDs
clusters <- unique(all_markers_stromal$group)

# 4️⃣ Extract top 30 genes for each cluster
top_genes_list <- list()

for (clust in clusters) {
  top_genes <- all_markers_stromal %>%
    filter(group == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%
    pull(feature)
  
  top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]] <- top_genes
}

# 5️⃣ Print top 30 marker genes for each cluster
for (clust in names(top_genes_list)) {
  cat("=== ", clust, " ===\n")
  print(top_genes_list[[clust]])
  cat("\n")
}
```

#8-THE PROPORTION OF DONORS IN EACH CLUSTERS
```{r,fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)


# Make sure dplyr functions are used explicitly
meta = stromal_obj@meta.data

#the  percentage 
donors_counts = meta %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters,Donors) %>% #count cells each donor use in each cluster
  dplyr::summarise( n= dplyr::n(),.groups = "drop") %>% #numb of cells
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n /sum(n))  #fraction of cells per donor

 
#plot
my_colors <- brewer.pal(12, "Set3") #color
p= ggplot(donors_counts, aes(x = harmony_clusters, y = proportion, fill = Donors)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 1)), #to see the proportion 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(title = "PROPORTION OF Donor in STROMAL_CLUSTER ",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Proportion of cells") +
  theme_minimal()
p
  #save
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/Prop_donor_stromal.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8)
```




#9-Correlation of cluster gene expression based on marker genes only. -AverageExpression (using only the marker genes for all clusters)

#9-1 the AverageExpression with markers genes(within clusters)
```{r}
#1-EXTRACT THE MARKER GENES#####
library(openxlsx)
colnames(all_markers_stromal)

#select 
marker = all_markers_stromal[, c("gene", "cluster", "avg_log2FC", "p_val_adj")]
#remove duplicate
marker_genes = unique(marker)

#2-GET UNIQUE MARKER GENES
marker_genes = unique(all_markers_stromal$gene)

#3 filter MG
#all genes in rna assay
gene_in_stromal = rownames(stromal_obj[["RNA"]])

#only genes present in the object
marker_genes_filtered <- marker_genes[marker_genes %in% gene_in_stromal]

length(marker_genes_filtered)  # should be > 0

#4 averageEpression per cluster
avr_exp = AverageExpression(
  stromal_obj,
  features = marker_genes_filtered,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)

#3 to get the matrix 
avr_exp_matrix = avr_exp$RNA
dim(avr_exp_matrix)


```


#9-1-1PLOT
```{r}
#plot
library(pheatmap)
p=pheatmap(
  avr_exp_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  main = "Average Expression of Marker Genes per BEC_Cluster"
)
p
ggsave(
  filename = "output/temp/avr_stromal.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)
```

#9-2 THE CORRELATION 
```{r}
#1-correlation between clusters
#need numeric matrix
avr_exp_matrix = as.matrix(avr_exp$RNA)
#correlation
cluster_cor = cor(avr_exp_matrix,method = "spearman") # or spearman
```




#9-2-2 PLOT
```{r}
#plots
p=pheatmap(
  cluster_cor,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  main = "Cluster Correlation based on STROMAL Markers Genes"
)
p

#to save
ggsave(file ="output/temp/cor_stromal.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

#10 ANNOTATION:USE THE CORRELATION AND THE DOTPLOT TO DO THE ANNOTATION
```{r}
#BASED ON THE EXPRESSION OF MARKERS FROM #5 and the CORRELATION LETS ANNOTATE
new_ann = c(
  "0"="advSC", "1"="advSC", "2"="VSMC", "3"="advSC", "4"="advSC", "5"="VSMC", "6"="advSC", "7"="advSC", "8"="VSMC", "9"="VSMC", "10"="FRC", "11"="advSC", "12"="FDC", "13"="advSC"
)

#Save the cell type labels in metadata
stromal_obj$new_ann = (mapvalues(
  x = as.character(stromal_obj$harmony_clusters),#map numb as string
  from = names(new_ann),
  to = new_ann
))

 #Convert to factor and drop unused levels
stromal_obj$new_ann <- factor(stromal_obj$new_ann, levels = unique(new_ann))
table(stromal_obj$new_ann)
plt = DimPlot(
  stromal_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = "new_ann",   # legend will show cell type names
  label = T,            # optional: add labels on UMAP
  repel = TRUE,            # avoid overlapping labels
  pt.size = 0.5
) 
plt

ggsave(
  filename = "output/temp/stromal_annotation_umap.png",
  plot = plt,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)
```
